title: RTEC 2022 EEO-1 Component 1 report — source identity and extraction reconciliation

discrepancy.finding: The safe archive inventory records binary SHA-256 edb159... for the 2022 PDF, while the preexisting deterministic-text extraction declares SHA-256 0da647....
discrepancy.interpretation: The two hashes must not be treated as the same hash field without establishing whether the extraction hash was computed from transformed/normalized content or came from a distinct binary.
discrepancy.required_action: Preserve both identities and link them as a probable source/extraction pair only by filename/source-id provenance until the original PDF bytes can be rehashed against the extraction manifest.

table_quality_boundary: The extracted report text preserves report/form metadata but the workforce demographic matrix is spatially flattened and not safe to interpret cell-by-cell without layout-aware parsing.
Do not promote person-level employee roster data to reconstruct the EEO-1 report.
If exact job-category/demographic totals are needed, parse the original aggregate PDF/table directly or use an aggregate source designed for that purpose.
